Start date: 1840-12-27  
Add 41 weeks = 287 days.  
Add 4 days → total add 291 days.  
1840 is a leap year (divisible by 4, before 1900 rule), so Dec 27 + 4 days → Dec 31 (1840), then remaining 287 days.  
From Jan 1, 1841: 287 days.  
Jan (31) + Feb (28, 1841 not leap) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) = 243 days.  
287 − 243 = 44 days left → into September.  
September 1 + 43 days = September 44 → October 14, 1841.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1841-10-14
